name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2014-06-24.19.1) proposed by Liberal Minister [Christopher Pyne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/sturt/christopher_pyne).
